name: pop_commitment
invariant: Pop removes exactly the committed object from Omega, appends exactly one event, and leaves earlier events unchanged.
explanation: A plain state snapshot after Pop(1) looks identical whether Pop(1) happened once or was somehow replayed twice; the append-only history is what lets an observer distinguish 'committed once, long ago' from 'committed just now, again'. Recording only the resulting Omega would erase that provenance.
